review_kind: Inline invariant review supported by executable witnesses; not an independent reviewer claim
selection_lifetime: A blocker bucket is created only after the corresponding candidate is selected. It is popped and fully drained on removal, before another candidate can be selected for that domain.
deletion_uniqueness: Both selection and forward checking call candidate only for live IDs. Rejection removes the ID before adding one bucket entry, preventing duplicate ownership.
static_safety: Static failures enter bad bits and no dynamic bucket. Existing restore logic never restores a static-bad ID.
rollback_safety: Chronological DFS removes child selections before an ancestor. Retaining an ancestor bucket therefore cannot preserve a conflict after its actual blocker has changed.
bounds: Total live dynamic entries are bounded by candidate count and candidate-work allowance. Bucket containers are bounded by selected obligation count. Every drain iteration checks the shared deadline.
caller_contract: select input and result types unchanged; runtime and existing witnesses pass. Admission adds the explicit blocker_bucket_bound field.
factory_gate: POLICY_BOUND; no complete construction or rated acceptance
